description: Star Chime joins the site arcade: an audio-first sequence-memory game where four pads sing a growing tune across twelve rounds, with three lives, two hints a round, and the games index listing all four games.
lead: The arcade grows a fourth shelf. Star Chime is an audio-first memory game with a tune that grows by one note each round, and the games index lists it beside the earlier games. Everything is vanilla script and tokens, with hashed same-origin assets and no network calls.
merge_note: Pre-merge: this entry ships in the same change per the standing rule; the merge identifier is recorded after the gate passes on the exact head.

title: Star Chime joins the arcade
